Added an explicit PDF selection count and a plain-language tied peak-hour summary.
Preserved the contracted KPI semantic marker so the evidence collector could mechanically observe the redesigned surface.
unresolved_risks: Independent critics left non-blocking medium refinements for secondary-text readability, export taxonomy, and daily-versus-hourly attendance terminology.
Actual PDF file generation and paid or external AI generation remained excluded from this visual calibration contract.
Repository-wide web lint remains polluted by generated .next-dev output; targeted Analytics lint and web typecheck passed.
reusable_knowledge_delta: Objective geometry and state validators cannot replace independent visual judgment; both layers are required for closure.
Source-revision validation must allow closure evidence to bind to the repaired revision while preserving the baseline contract revision.
Structural UI refactors must preserve or deliberately migrate semantic evidence markers.
When comparison data is unavailable, improve KPI hierarchy through honest grouping and footprint reduction rather than fabricated trends.
